children.name: Warnstorfia fluitans
children.description: Warnstorfia fluitans, the floating hook-moss or water hook-moss, is a species of moss found in acidic habitats across all continents except Antarctica.

children.name: Warnstorfia exannulata
children.description: Warnstorfia exannulata is a leafy branching wetland moss in the genus Warnstorfia within the family Amblystegiaceae and class Bryopsida.

children.name: Calliergon cordifolium
children.description: Calliergon cordifolium is a species of moss in the Calliergonaceae family, commonly known as the calliergon moss (though this name refers to the genus Calliergon generally) The species is abundant in the right habitat, and grows in marshes and wet woodland, especially woodland of alder (Alnus) or willow (Salix), as well as around streams, ditches and pools.

children.name: Calliergon giganteum
children.description: Calliergon giganteum, the giant spearmoss, giant calliergon moss, or arctic moss, is an aquatic plant found on lake beds in tundra regions.

children.name: Sarmentypnum exannulatum
children.description: Sarmentypnum exannulatum, also known as ringless hook-moss, is a species of medium-sized wetland moss belonging to the family Amblystegiaceae.

children.name: Calliergonella cuspidata
children.description: Calliergonella cuspidata is a species of moss belonging to the family Pylaisiaceae.
